purpose: fewer delegated rounds from the libc: no fcntl after an O_CLOEXEC open, 8 KiB stdio and 32 KiB getdents buffers, identity and clock from the launch record, thread setup and chdir without a round
platform: firmware capstone-sbi a810177 (no S-mode swap), modcapstone one-ecall module, capstone-qemu ac2837aa (timer quantum); kernel e833dfb1...; base: launcher 991bc7dc... with the pinned musl and images (review-perl-v2.dom, mruby.dom, contracts); new: launcher built from this commit with -Wall -Wextra -O2, musl 1.2.5 with musl-patches/, perl and mruby relinked with ports/common/application/build.py against it
method: capstone-vm run with CAPSTONE_DELEGATE_STATS=1; rounds are the launcher's count; ticks are rdtime wall time from after seccomp install to exit and include the interpreter's own execution; Perl t/base through prove --exec from the host, nine launches; host shared with another session's guest and a parallel compile job (load 15-21)
note: the intermediate runs 'new' (launcher built without optimisation: perl startup 53 s vs 10 s in the guest) and 'new2' (host load: gate cancellation timeout, t/base 170 s) are in the log directory and not results; base2 and new3 ran back to back under the same load
